title: Disable cramfs Kernel Module
description: Checks if the cramfs kernel module exists on the target host and, if present, disables it by blacklisting, creating an install directive, and unloading the module.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address of the target Linux host where cramfs will be disabled.

playbook_output.description: What the emit step's <result> block contains

fields.name: remediation_performed
fields.description: True if any remediation action was taken (module existed), false otherwise.

fields.name: actions
fields.description: List of strings describing the actions that were (or would have been) taken.

fields.name: status_message
fields.description: A human-readable summary of the outcome.

steps.name: Check for cramfs module directories
steps.function: Find any existing cramfs kernel module directories under /lib/modules.

steps.name: Does the cramfs module exist?
steps.function: Branch based on whether any cramfs module directory was found.
steps.condition: At least one cramfs kernel module directory is found.

steps.name: Ensure install directive
steps.function: Add the 'install cramfs /bin/false' line to /etc/modprobe.d/cramfs.conf if not already present.

steps.name: Ensure blacklist directive
steps.function: Add the 'blacklist cramfs' line to /etc/modprobe.d/cramfs.conf if not already present.

steps.name: Unload cramfs module
steps.function: Attempt to remove the cramfs module from the running kernel, ignoring errors if already unloaded.

steps.name: Build actions list and result (module present)
steps.function: Compile the actions taken from the three remediation steps and set the success result variables.

computations._actions: Create a list: if _install_result is changed, add 'install directive added' else 'install directive already present'; if _blacklist_result is changed, add 'blacklist directive added' else 'blacklist directive already present'; always add 'module unload attempted'.

steps.name: Set no-op result (module absent)
steps.function: Set the result variables to indicate that no remediation was necessary.

computations._status_message: 'cramfs module not present on system, no remediation necessary'

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the final <result> block with remediation status, actions taken, and a summary message.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the error output and fails.

phases.name: Discovery
phases.description: Detect whether the cramfs module exists under /lib/modules.

phases.name: Remediation
phases.description: Apply blacklisting, install directive, and module unload when the module is present.

phases.name: Result assembly
phases.description: Build the final result variables for either the remediation or no-op path.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured output to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
